post.title: Brilliant place to stay! – dollyface99
post.html: Just wanted to write another quick review for this place. We stayed here for the first time about a year ago under sad circunstances followng the illness and death of my father in law. Since then we have stayed here many times more (every other month or so while visiting mother in law) and we can still say without doubt this is a fab place to stay! They bend over backwards to look after you, are very flexible and friendly. Its great if you have a dog as the cottages are dog friendly and there are lots of lovely walks too! Its a very reasonable cost and the shower is great- really powerful!! If you looking for somewhere quiet and peaceful to stay, then look no further!
